items.heading: Explains that the four phases HB TM are similar to a person whose soul is clothed in his body, and the body is clothed in a garment, and he sits in his chamber: Hochma is the collective of the lights in the world of Atzilut, and it is the soul of the whole of Atzilut, and is called the upper man. It is clothed in Bina, which is the collective of the vessels called the body of Atzilut. And over the body, ZA clothes, which is the garment. And Malchut is the chamber for them all. In it there are four matters: — 1. The four phases HB TM are called: soul, body, garment, chamber. This is the world of Atzilut, within which the upper man sits, who is a soul clothed in a body, and in a garment, and in the chamber of a king. 2. Keter is the root for them, and it divides into four: the root for the soul is Hochma of Keter. And Bina of Keter is the root for the body. And ZA of Keter is the root for the garment. And Malchut of Keter is the root for the chamber. 3. And all that has been explained in the world of Atzilut also applies in the world of Beria, which is a light of offshoot. For Beria was imprinted from the world of Atzilut, in such a way that Keter of Keter of Atzilut imprints Keter of Keter in Beria. And Hochma of Keter imprints Hochma of Keter in Beria, meaning the soul of Keter. And Bina of Keter imprints the soul of Keter in Beria, and so on, and likewise in all the Sefirot. 4. The lights are not extended directly from Keter of Atzilut to Keter of Beria, for the world of Beria receives only through Malchut of Atzilut. And everything that is in the world of Atzilut, Malchut of Atzilut imprints in the world of Beria. And likewise in the world of Yetzira and Assiya. — The four phases HB TM are called: soul, body, garment, chamber. This is the world of Atzilut, within which the upper man sits, who is a soul clothed in a body, and in a garment, and in the chamber of a king.
items.html: *And after we have explained that all the emanated are one phase, comprising all four foundations, which are the four letters of HaVaYaH, which are the four worlds ABYA, and that they have a fifth, upper phase, an intermediary between them and Ein Sof, we shall now explain each world in general, and afterward, with God's help, we shall return to explain them all together as a single generality.

items.heading: Everything that exists in all the worlds ABYA is only four phases HB TM, which are the four letters Yod-Hei-Vav-Hei. And they are: soul, body, garments, house.
items.html: And behold, everything that was created in all the worlds is only four phases, which are HaVaYaH as above. And they are: the spiritual phase 1called soul, and the phase of the body's limbs, and the phase of the garments, and the phase of the house.

items.heading: The light in Atzilut is the spirituality called soul. It is Hochma. And the soul is clothed in the vessels of Atzilut called body.
items.html: And let us speak of the world of Atzilut, and from it all the rest will be understood. For behold, the inner part of the whole of Atzilut is the spirituality called soul, and it is clothed within the limbs of the body called vessels, which are 2the ten Sefirot called head, arms, and body.

items.heading: There are ten vessels in the body, which are the ten Sefirot in limit and measure that exist in Atzilut. This is Bina.
items.html: And let us return to the matter of 3the body, for this phase is the ten Sefirot, ten measures, for they have limit and measure, as is written in the chapters of the Heichalot concerning the Shiur Koma, which is two hundred and thirty-six thousand myriads of parasangs, and so on.

items.heading: And the body of Atzilut is clothed in garments. This is ZA, which clothes Bina.
items.html: And this body is clothed within the garments of Atzilut, as our sages said, the Holy One, blessed be He, clothed Himself in ten garments, a garment of pride, as it is written, "The Lord reigns, He is clothed in majesty," and this is the secret mentioned in the chapters of the Heichalot, that there 4the robe of the Creator, blessed be He, is called Zahariel, and so on. But in the soul that is within, there is no measure at all; however 5relative to Ein Sof, we may call them by the name of measures and Sefirot even with respect to the soul.

items.heading: The garments dwell within the houses, which are the seven Heichalot of Atzilut, which are Malchut. And taken all together, it is regarded that the upper man, who is a soul clothed in a body, and the body in garments, is placed in the chamber of a king.
items.html: And behold, these garments are within the phase of the houses, which are the seven Heichalot of Atzilut, which are the phase of the world itself, which are the heavens and the earth, and the air between them, for all this is the phase of the houses, and they are called the world of Atzilut, within which the upper man sits, who is soul and body, and the garments of Malchut are placed in the chamber of the supernal King, which is the whole generality of the world of Atzilut.

items.heading: The four phases, soul, body, garment, chamber, are HB TM. And Keter is a fifth to them, in which are the roots of these four revealed phases.
items.html: And these four phases are the phase of the ten Sefirot, which begin from Hochma above, and there are four phases in them as above, and moreover, there is the phase of Keter, which is the fifth phase mentioned above, the root for them all, and it too contains the root of the four phases mentioned above.

items.heading: In each of the four revealed phases in Atzilut there are ten Sefirot HB TM. And the soul in Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot HB TM of the soul in Atzilut. And the body of Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot HB TM of the bodies. And the garments of Keter are the root for the ten Sefirot HB TM of the garments. And the chamber in Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot HB TM of the chambers.
items.html: It follows, then, that the phase of the light and the soul in Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot of the souls of Atzilut, which begin from Hochma as above, 6and the phase of the body in Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot of the bodies within the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, which begin from Hochma as above, and the phase of the garments in Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot of the garments within the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, which begin from Hochma as above, and the phase of the chamber in Keter is the root for the ten Sefirot of the chambers within the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, which begin from Hochma as above.

items.heading: Everything that is in the world of Atzilut is imprinted in the world of Beria.
items.html: Afterward, the world of Beria was created, in exactly the same way as above, for by way of 7the screen, which is the ground of the chamber of Atzilut, it shone below, and there was imprinted there 8a stamp of everything that had been in the world of Atzilut, and it is called the world of Beria, since it is 9a light of offshoot, and is not the upper light itself; and indeed, since it is the stamp of Atzilut, it must contain all the phases that are in Atzilut.

items.heading: Keter of Atzilut imprints the four roots HB TM in Keter of Beria. And from the soul in Keter of Atzilut, the soul in Keter of Beria is imprinted. And from the body in Keter of Atzilut, the body in Keter of Beria is imprinted. And from the garment, garment. And from the chamber, chamber.
items.html: And it is that the phase of Keter, which is the fifth phase comprising the four phases mentioned above, imprints a Keter at the head of Beria similar to itself, and from the light of Keter of Atzilut, the light of Keter of Beria is imprinted, and from the body of Keter of Atzilut, the body of Keter of Beria is imprinted, and from the garment of Keter of Atzilut, the garment of Keter of Beria is imprinted, and from the chamber of Keter of Atzilut, the chamber of Keter of Beria is imprinted.

items.heading: The revealed phases of Keter of Atzilut, which are extended to the revealed phases of Keter of Beria, are extended by Malchut of Atzilut, which clothed in Keter of Beria. And likewise the rest of the Sefirot of Atzilut that were imprinted in Beria were extended by way of Malchut of Atzilut, through the secret of the coupling by striking upon the screen within her.
items.html: Rather, these lights were not extended from Keter of Atzilut itself to Keter of Beria, but by way of Malchut within Malchut of Atzilut, which is Atik of Beria, as above, which clothes in Keter of Beria, and it was she who extended these four phases in Keter of Atzilut, and created them in Keter of Beria, and likewise the ten Sefirot of Atzilut did, and they extended their light by way of the aforementioned Malchut, which is in the aforementioned Keter, and imprinted the stamp of Atzilut in Beria: soul from soul, body from body, garment from garment, chamber from chamber.

items.heading: Malchut of Beria, which descended and clothed in Keter of Yetzira, extended the stamp of the five Partzufim KHB TM of Beria, which are the revealed phases, to the world of Yetzira: souls from souls, body from body, garment from garment, chamber from chamber. And likewise in Yetzira and Assiya.
items.html: And so it is likewise in Yetzira, for Malchut of Beria was Atik, joined with AA of Yetzira, and there it is called Keter of Yetzira, and the five Partzufim of Beria extended and imprinted their stamp in Yetzira, in the manner mentioned above regarding Beria: souls from souls, and bodies from bodies, garments from garments, and chambers from chambers. And likewise the five Partzufim of Yetzira imprinted their phases in Assiya: souls from souls, and bodies from bodies, garments from garments, and chambers from chambers, and likewise as above, all the worlds together as a single generality.
